title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Oct 01, 2023 - Sep 30, 2025

description.narrative:
Policy 1: Sustainable financing and strategic purchasing for UHC Outcome 1: Percentage of out-of-pocket expenditure decreased to 31.9% of current health expenditure (2019 baseline: 48.8%, 2021 update: 41.9%) Source: PSA, annual National Health Accounts
Action 2: The government, (i) through DOH, DBM, DOF and PHIC, will make the government subsidy per family equivalent to the minimum premium contribution amount of the direct contributory member, and ensure that all indirect contributory members as recognized by law are provided with government subsidies, (ii) through DOH, will implement technical guidelines for local government units in the implementation of climate-resilient and -smart health-related PPPs, and (iii) through DOH, fully implement the Financial Management and Reporting Enhancement Program (PhilHealth FinMaRep), which will include provisions for specifically allocating, tracking and managing climate finance. (DOH, DBM, DOF, PHIC) Target date: 2025-09-30
Action 3: The government, through DOH and PHIC, will ensure alignment of all medical assistance to include the DOH-managed Medical Assistance for Indigents and Financially Incapacitated Patients, Cancer Assistance Fund, PCSO Medical Access Program Fund, any PHIC supplemental benefits scheme, and all other national and local government health funding programs with PHIC benefits and covered services, including their comprehensive coverage of breast, cervical, ovarian cancers, and maternity care and delivery, and climate change-sensitive diseases, including nutrition and vector-borne diseases, while ensuing preferential coverage of primary care services. (DOH, PHIC) Target date: 2025-09-30
Action 4: The government, through DOH and PHIC, (i) in consultation with the Insurance Commission and with the active involvement of patient groups, Association of Health Maintenance Organizations of the Philippines, Philippine Association of Doctors and other health professionals, Philippine Life Insurers and Reinsurers Association and other UHC stakeholders, will implement coordinated benefits provided by private health insurance (including health maintenance organizations) with PHIC, including coordination in the coverage of diagnostic tests for women such as breast, cervical, and ovarian cancer screening, maternity care and deliveries, and climate sensitive diseases (e.g., vector-borne diseases and NCDs), and the coverage of non-PHIC covered health services by private health insurers, and (ii) will implement the UHC Act provisions specifying that private hospitals must allocate 10% of their hospital bed as no-balance billing or non-co-payment beds for PHIC members. (DOH, PHIC) Target date: 2025-09-30
Action 5: To improve access to medicines and medical devices, the government, through DOH, will implement: (i) improved access pathways to medicines and medical devices; (ii) streamlined government policies and processes that influence access to medicines, medical devices, and other health commodities; and (iii) a platform that will facilitate efficiency and quality assurance in national and local government procurement of medicines, medical devices, and other health commodities. (DOH) Target date: 2025-09-30
Action 6: The government, (i) through PHIC, will consolidate Konsulta+SDG benefits with other outpatient benefits and implement its nationwide roll-out, including coverage of climate-change related conditions and sexual and reproductive health services responding to the needs of women and all genders, for all members and dependents including senior citizens and persons with disabilities, and (ii) through DOH and PHIC, will transfer PHIC reimbursements and/or DOH financial grants, on a continuing basis starting in 2025, to at least one special health fund for a network of providers per region in all 17 regions, particularly in BARMM. (DOH, PHIC) Target date: 2025-09-30
Action 7: The government, through PHIC and DOH, will pilot and assess the global budget provider payment method that includes no-balance billing rules and government counterpart financing, incorporates updated costing of inpatient cases and Konsulta+ capitation rates, and inclusive of the coverage of inpatient women's health services and climate change-sensitive conditions. (DOH, PHIC) Target date: 2025-09-30
